recommendation_scope: Current fully automated cut/constraint configuration, not all pattern-based modeling
inspection: All 14 final trial3 PNGs and all 12 matched Recovery v2 comparison PNGs visually inspected; trial1 and trial2 inspected in representative front/3q/side/back/stress images, not asserted as complete 14-image visual reviews.

issues.observation: Wide opening exposes the underlying mannequin torso; overlap collapses into thin pointed crossing strips. Under leaf wrinkles severely during raising.
issues.cause_hypothesis: Front cut ease/overlap and sparse hem constraints do not fit the body; band inherits the failed drape. Post-drape finishing band is not independently sewn/simulated.
issues.future_change: Fit a measured front neckline/overlap cut with controlled collar width before solving; test band as an actual sewn component.
issues.predicted_effect: A broad stable crossover with supported outer band, instead of a pointed lower X. Not implemented.

issues.observation: Crushed angular seam folds, discontinuous-looking shoulder contact and visible body exposure in stress view.
issues.cause_hypothesis: Panel rest lengths/placement/anchor tensions conflict; residual sewing gaps are force-welded after solve.
issues.future_change: Human-fit the shoulder/armhole cut and seam rest-length pairing, consider a small gusset, validate sew closure before freezing.
issues.predicted_effect: Smoother contact and distributed tension. Not implemented.

issues.observation: Gravity bag is readable in raised/horizontal solve but narrow/crumpled in neutral. Rig-only horizontal raise leaves arm above/through the upper cloth edge.
issues.cause_hypothesis: Cut/initial placement/support constraints do not preserve intended neutral silhouette; heuristic skinning cannot reproduce pose-specific gravity/contact.
issues.future_change: Re-establish the sleeve cut after human art review; separately author armhole weights, accepted pose correctives and secondary controls.
issues.predicted_effect: Preserved sleeve bag plus pose-safe upper edge. Not implemented.
